desc.lead_name: The lead's first name (same as first_name).
desc.when: When the lead's enquiry or quote happened.
desc.agent_name: The name the AI goes by. Empty uses the account's default AI name.
desc.ai_role: The job title the AI claims. Empty uses the account's default role.
desc.ai_style: How the AI writes. Empty uses the account's default style.
desc.typo_frequency: How often the AI makes a human-looking typo.
desc.typo_count: The most typos allowed per message.
desc.language: The language the AI writes in. A language set on the lead wins.
desc.company_name: The business the AI says it works for.
desc.business: The business name, same as company_name.
desc.business_description: What the business does. Empty uses the account's description.
desc.service: The service this campaign sells, in a word or two.
desc.service_name: The service's full name. Empty uses service.
desc.usp: Why this business over another: its unique selling point.
desc.kb: Facts the AI may use: prices, hours, service area, policies.
desc.niche: The trade. It also decides which niche words the prompt gets.
desc.niche_question: The question the AI asks to learn the lead's situation.
desc.qualification_criteria: What makes a lead a good fit.
desc.calendar_link: The booking link. On a live chat each lead gets a personal link built from it.
desc.booking_mode: How a booking works: a call with the team, or direct booking.
desc.calling_number: The number the booking confirmation promises a call from.
desc.call_mode: How the booked call happens: phone, WhatsApp or video.
desc.what_lead_did: What the lead did before. It sets lead_stage. The lead's own value wins.
desc.lead_context: Specifics about the lead's enquiry or quote. The lead's own value wins.
desc.first_touch: How the business first met the lead.
desc.first_message: The opener the lead received. You edit the template, with its {variables}.
desc.ai_disclosure: When the AI says it is an AI: off, in the opener, or in its second message.
desc.lead_stage: Where the lead stands: inquired, deciding, quoted or owner.
desc.conversation_mode: The flow: scoping builds the brief, decision discusses a quote.
desc.voice_mode: Whether this reply is a voice note.
desc.voice_live: Which live voice engine answers this turn, if any.
desc.immediate_callback: Whether the AI may promise a call right now.
desc.opener_names_job: Whether the opener already named the quoted job.
desc.decision_opener: Decision flow only: named or unnamed job in the opener.
desc.quoted_first_reply: How the first reply after a job-naming opener is worded.
desc.disclosure_clause: The sentence in the opener that says this is an AI.
desc.lead_source: How the lead arrived, on special flows such as a social comment.
desc.social_context: The post and comment a social lead reacted to.
desc.today_date: Today's date, so the AI can reason about time.
desc.project_term: The niche's word for the job or project.
desc.project_term_list: All accepted words for the job, comma-separated. The first is the main one.
desc.proposal_term: The niche's word for a quote or proposal.
desc.proposal_term_list: All accepted words for a quote, comma-separated. The first is the main one.
desc.decision_term: The niche's word for the buying decision.
desc.decision_term_list: All accepted words for the decision, comma-separated. The first is the main one.
desc.advisor_term: The niche's word for the human expert.
desc.advisor_term_list: All accepted words for the expert, comma-separated. The first is the main one.
desc.visit_term: The niche's word for a visit or appointment.
desc.visit_term_list: All accepted words for the visit, comma-separated. The first is the main one.
desc.niche_question_bank: Example questions that fit this niche.
desc.niche_bad_examples: Replies the AI must not imitate in this niche.
desc.niche_objection_examples: Common objections in this niche, with good answers.
desc.niche_scenario_examples: Worked examples of situations in this niche.
desc.niche_scoping_ladder: The questions, in order, that build the brief for this niche.
desc.opener_phrase: The short phrase naming the job in the opener.
desc.campaignname: The campaign's name, in a report.
desc.campaignstatus: The campaign's status, in a report.
desc.campaigndescription: The campaign's description, in a report.
desc.totalleads: How many leads the campaign holds.
desc.responserate: The share of leads that replied.
desc.bookingrate: The share of leads that booked.

note.lead: From the lead. Shown with this campaign's first lead.
note.today: Filled in when the message is written.
note.stats: Live numbers in a real report. The preview shows sample numbers.
note.leadStage: Worked out from what the lead did.
note.conversationMode: Worked out from the lead stage.
note.perTurn: Set per message. The preview shows a normal text message.
note.demoCallback: On for demo campaigns during office hours.
note.openerFlow: Set by the opener that was sent.
note.socialDemo: Only set on a lead from a social comment.
note.nicheRow: From the niche, edited on the Demos page.
note.demoContext: Picked per demo from the client's enquiry or quote.
note.demoNumber: The demo's own number for its market.
note.bookingMode: Set by the engine: a call on every campaign, a demo client can switch it.
note.voiceAgent: Set in Call settings, where a new name also updates the greeting and follows the voice.
note.voiceHandoff: Worked out from the transfer and unwanted-call settings. Saving a number there also rewires the line.
note.voiceFollowup: Decided per caller, so the preview leaves it empty.
note.voiceKnowledge: Built from the account's knowledge base and the persona.
note.voiceDisclosure: Depends on the phone line's AI disclosure setting, which has no editor yet.
note.voiceService: From the live persona's row, which the Demos page can't edit.
note.voiceCity: Not filled on client lines: the words around it drop out.
note.voiceTask: The saved business prompt for this line's language.
note.voiceDetails: Built per call: knowledge, client setup, caller and today's date.
note.voiceLanguage: Set in Call settings, where the name can follow it.
note.voiceNotFilled: It would reach the call as typed.

vars.pickAccount: Pick a client to see and edit values.
vars.voiceGeneric: This render is generic, not this line, so it can't be saved here.
vars.noPersona: This account has no persona of its own yet.
vars.intakeOverridden: Saved, but this line's buying checklist asks its own questions.

voiceDesc.agent: The receptionist's name on the phone.
voiceDesc.agent_name: The receptionist's name on the phone.
voiceDesc.company: The business the receptionist answers for.
voiceDesc.company_name: The business the receptionist answers for.
voiceDesc.business_line: One line on what the business does, plus the AI sentence when the line says it is an AI.
voiceDesc.business_description: What the business does, for the part that reasons behind the voice.
voiceDesc.tone: How the receptionist comes across, in your own words. Empty uses the traits picked in onboarding.
voiceDesc.address: Whether callers are addressed formally or informally.
voiceDesc.pronunciation: How to say difficult words and names.
voiceDesc.intake: What the team wants to know for an appointment, one item per line. Empty uses the persona's questions.
voiceDesc.client_rules: This client's own rules, one per line. They reach the voice and the part behind it.
voiceDesc.handoff: What happens when a caller asks for a person, and who gets through.
voiceDesc.followup: Whether to offer a WhatsApp message after the call.
voiceDesc.knowledge: The business facts the receptionist can answer from without looking anything up.
voiceDesc.disclosure: The sentence in the greeting that says this is an AI.
voiceDesc.city: The city the business is in.
voiceDesc.you: The word for "you" in the greeting.
voiceDesc.task_instructions: Where the saved business prompt goes in this frame.
voiceDesc.call_details: Where the details of this call go in this frame.
voiceDesc.calling_number: A chat variable. Voice calls don't fill it.
voiceDesc.call_mode: A chat variable. Voice calls don't fill it.
